We use fermionic Matsubara frequencies $\omega_n = (2n+1)\pi/\beta$ with integer $n$, and $\beta>0$.
Since $e^{i\omega_n\beta}=-1$, the imaginary-time integral of the phase factor is
\begin{equation}
\int_0^{\beta} d\tau\, e^{i(2n+1)\pi\tau/\beta} = \frac{2i\beta}{(2n+1)\pi} .
\label{eq:mats}
\end{equation}
